in_marathi.name: Oorjit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining, Victorious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Oorjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Oorjit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'oorjah' meaning radiant or shining. The name is also associated with victory and triumph. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra, the god of rain and thunder, is referred to as Oorjit. The name is considered auspicious and bestowed upon children to bring them prosperity, success, and happiness.

In Hindu mythology, there is a god named Vīrabhadra, who is known as the embodiment of this quality. Thus, the name Oorjit carries the spiritual significance of being a brave and strong individual.
